concept: A $15,000 bet told as a Y2K desktop meltdown: the story is a talking head, the jokes are glitches that break the frame at each turn.
law: Paper and ink carry the words; red marks money and the word that matters; pink and cyan only appear inside a glitch; the one blue sky is the MS Paint sky of reference 1 and only opens for the soul beat. Greg's face is never covered and never cut; the two Instagram inserts are never cropped.
motif: The torn paper strip: hook headline, caption strips, the divider between stacked hosts, the tape on the insert windows and the tear that opens the sky.

options.name: A
options.idea: Post-Internet collage: Win95 windows, giant condensed type with black offset, torn paper, red accent, pink/cyan glitch (user's primary references 1-3).

options.name: B
options.idea: Monochrome editorial: black-and-white footage, RGB split on hits, grid and barcode footer (reference 4).

options.name: C
options.idea: Minimal grey with one red circle and a red italic serif accent word (reference 6).

approval_note: User picked references 1-3 as the primary direction and approved the written style guide (palette, fonts, design pieces) in chat before the build; no separate styleframe sheet was shown.
